queries.query: Please visually validate the responsive dashboard card grid in the browser at mobile, breakpoint-edge, desktop, and wide-desktop widths. Check long titles, keyboard focus, clipping, alignment, and spacing, fix anything you find, and recapture the affected states.

The new Three.js scene sometimes appears blank after resizing. Inspect the rendered page and screenshots across phone and desktop sizes, verify that the canvas has visible pixels and remains framed correctly, and report the evidence.
Build a reusable React settings-card component from the approved design, add loading and empty variants, and expose it in Storybook for the product team.
Replace the repeated hex values in our theme with semantic surface, text, border, and action tokens, then document when each token should be used.

Before release, verify the implemented dashboard against the runnable designs reference at the same route and viewport. Build a matched-element inventory, compare rendered DOM styles and geometry for the default, open-menu, and keyboard-focus states, and return a CLEAN, FINDINGS, or BLOCKED visual-validation report.

There is no prototype for the new notification settings panel. Review whether it is visually consistent with the existing profile and billing panels, including typography, spacing, borders, responsive geometry, focus states, and accessibility, and include DOM evidence for each affected element.

Manually verify the notification-settings acceptance criteria: an editor can save preferences, a viewer cannot edit them, saved values survive reload, validation errors are shown, and the success redirect reaches the correct route. Report pass or fail evidence for each scenario.
